explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` to parse the fragment in BODY context, then walked tokens with `next_token()` and rebuilt the document by concatenating `serialize_token()` for unchanged tokens. For ordinary `#text` tokens whose decoded text contains the keyword, I wrapped the token’s normalized serialization in `<mark>`, which leaves special-element contents alone because `script`, `style`, `title`, and `textarea` do not surface as ordinary `#text` tokens here.
